text:
Leaves are picked from the flalks, and flowers from
their crops. They are beaten in a marble mortar,
with a wooden peille, into a smooth mafs after
which three there weight of double-refined fugar is
added by degrees, and the beating continued till
they are uniformly mixed.

parsed.faithful: Leaves are picked from the falks, and flowers from their cups. They are beaten in a marble mortar, with a wooden peftle, into a fmooth mafs; after which thrice their weight of double-refined fugar is added by degrees, and the beating continued till they are uniformly mixed.
parsed.modern: Leaves are picked from the stalks, and flowers from their cups. They are beaten in a marble mortar, with a wooden pestle, into a smooth mass; after which thrice their weight of double-refined sugar is added by degrees, and the beating continued till they are uniformly mixed.
